subject: Upcoming Family Reunion Details
body: Dear Family Members, We are excited to announce the details for our upcoming family reunion! The event will take place on Saturday, June 12th at Central Park. We have planned fun activities for all ages, including games, a potluck lunch, and a family photo session. Please RSVP by June 5th to confirm your attendance and let us know if you have any dietary restrictions. We can't wait to see everyone and create lasting memories together. Looking forward to a wonderful reunion! Best regards, The Johnson Family
